Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: When opening the 2015 Kungahuset page, WebSurfer relayed the line stating “Prinsessan Sofia har fått en son” in the context of Prince Nicolas’s birth announcement. This is incorrect for Nicolas (his mother is Princess Madeleine). By echoing this contradictory snippet without flagging or verifying it, WebSurfer introduced misleading information, constituting the first mistake.
